title: Rabbi Chagga, Son-in-Law of Rav Ada bar Ahavah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman cites Yuchasin HaShalem for the name Chagga and reports that his text of Yevamot reads Rav Chana.

notes.text: The supplied notice contains a footnote marker [1] whose note text is missing. The William Davidson digital text of Yevamot 110b names Rav Chana as Rav Ada bar Ahavah’s son-in-law, supporting that comparison; it does not recover the missing footnote.

The London edition of Yuchasin HaShalem (1857, p. 135) calls Rav Ada bar Ahavah’s son-in-law Chagga. The passage on Yevamot 110b calls him Rav Chana. Wikisource’s note [1] is an editorial correction of Hyman’s printed reference from 100b to 110b.
